Scenario: User logs in with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid email/password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to the dashboard and session is created

Scenario: User logs in with invalid password
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid email, wrong password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message shown; user stays on login page

Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Leave fields blank 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Inline validation errors shown for required fields

Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Type into password field
Expected Result: Characters are masked; a toggle reveals/hides text

Steps: 1. Open product page 2. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: Cart icon updates count; item appears in cart summary

Scenario: User updates item quantity in cart
Steps: 1. Open cart 2. Increase quantity of an item
Expected Result: Line total and cart total recalculate correctly

Steps: 1. Open cart 2. Click Remove on an item
Expected Result: Item is removed; cart total updates; empty-cart state shown if last item

Scenario: User completes checkout with saved address
Steps: 1. Go to checkout 2. Select saved address 3. Confirm order
Expected Result: Order confirmation page shown with correct order summary

Steps: 1. Go to checkout 2. Enter invalid card number 3. Submit
Expected Result: Validation error shown; order is not placed
Confirmation email is queued/sent with correct order ID

Steps: 1. Turn off network 2. Open app 3. Attempt to load product list
Expected Result: Friendly offline message shown, no crash

Steps: 1. Open product list 2. Pull down to refresh
Expected Result: List reloads with a loading indicator and updated data
